mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_VENOM_MIST_* from Data/Player/HDK_HelmMale02.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:222-231; the helm is HDK_HelmMale 2). MU's number 30. Ours is *Male31 by the index-plus-one rule; MU never loads a *Male31 file.
why_this_one: The Soul Master's level-380 set, Kanturu's gear (the user, 2026-10-22: 'lets now cook kanturu weapons and armors', dormant until Kanturu drops them).

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (Season 2's level-380 sets; 0.75 and 0.95d have none).
stats.drops_from_monsters_note: Drops in Kanturu only (the user, 2026-10-25: "The 380 gear", "Kanturu only"): sim::kanturuGear keeps anything asking level 380 to the maps whose rules drop kanturu_gear. Its drop level is MU's.
stats.requires_note: MU asks level 380 (OpenMU's levelRequirement), and so does ours (the user, 2026-10-25: "Level 380"): found in the Ruins from 320, worn from 380. The stat columns are raw, scaled by the drop level as every item's.
stats.class_level_note: The Soul Master's alone: OpenMU's darkWizardClassLevel 2. sim::fits asks Wearer::second (docs/game/second-class-gear.md).

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player cobraset_*.OZJ and cobraset_hair.OZT, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py: violet plate and robe traced in gold; the helm's white hair card cut by its own alpha (17% away).
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate, the gold painted on (Dark Phoenix's lesson: plate_steel on a dark sheet goes polished black); the lower sheet's robe panels cloth, as Dark Soul's; the hair card hair.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, the paint left as it is.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_VENOM_MIST_* (no glow, no chrome pass). Its +10 boots' blue (0.1, 0.1, 0.9) set aura (ZzzCharacter.cpp:11004-11030) is not built: fx/set_shine has no 380 sets yet.
cutout_from: Declared: cobraset_hair.OZT's alpha is real (decode_texture: 17% cut away), the hair's ragged edge.
